'''2001 Tennessee State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship held in Tennessee in 2001.<ref name="dt-15568">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15568 Dark Surgeon], DeckTech (Alex "Greedo" Tennet, 24 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15568/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15568/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 May 2001<ref name="tr-d2294" />
* '''Site:''' Tennessee; Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="tr-d2294" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Jonny Chu]]<ref name="tr-d2304" />
The event is known from a player's DeckTech post, which gives no date.

Steven Lewis went 4–0, final included, with a variant of Alex Tennet's Dark Agents Of Black Sun deck; Tennet added this to his post as an update.<ref name="dt-15568" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub's only result row (from Alex Tennet's deck post) has Steven Lewis going 4–0 'final included'; this report's standings have Lewis first after the Swiss at 11 (+119) and Jonathan Chu winning the Final Confrontation by 1 point.<ref name="tr-d2304" />
* The hub's result row (from Alex Tennet's deck post) has Steven Lewis going 4–0 'final included'; Lewis's own report has him 6–0 in the Swiss and losing the two-game Final Confrontation to Jonny Chu by one differential.<ref name="tr-d2308" />
